findings.excerpt: We sell our substrate products directly to customers through our direct salesforce in the United States, China and Europe. We also use independent sales representatives and distributors in Japan, Taiwan, Korea and other areas.

findings.claim: AXT 與 Lumentum 簽定 InP 基板供應及產能預留協議，產能預留至 2031-12-31，Lumentum 付兩筆各 $43.5M 預付款並抵作出貨額度
findings.excerpt: Announces Long-Term Supplier Agreement with Lumentum FREMONT, Calif., July 29, 2026 – AXT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AXTI), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor substrates, today announced that it entered into a definitive agreement with Lumentum Operations, LLC for the supply and capacity reservation of indium phosphide wafer substrates.
